notes.title: Prices are revised in some countries
notes.notes:
Steam have changed to set a minimum price threshold.
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/3700310527377680732

Due to this effect, I have found that it is not possible to carry out discount sales correctly due to the low price in some areas.
On Steam, the recommended price for each country was raised around October 2022, but the price of this tool was left as it was. This is a problem caused by this.
I believe that not being able to hold discount sales is disadvantageous to both consumers and producers, so I will revise the prices in some areas that are clearly considered to be cheap.

The currency unit to be revised is as follows.

ARS Argentine Peso : 26,99 → 110,00
TRY Turkish lira        :   4,20 → 15,00

The price revision is scheduled to take place in about a month, taking into account publicity.

notes.title: New Live features are now available
notes.notes:
A new live feature is now available on Net Friend Joy Joypad with Live (NFJJ plus).

[h3] What has changed? [/h3]
I do not know too. Since the SDK of the new standard came out, it corresponded.
It seems that the development of the old standard SDK will be stopped, and it is not expected to improve the function as it is.
Also, the format has been changed to change the band size on the live distribution side.
I didn't see much of a feature difference in our local tests, but it might be a difference remotely.

notes.title: Please "Disable Steam Input" for this tool
notes.notes:
It seems that there is a problem that the controller cannot be recognized when Steam input is enabled due to a specification change of Steam or an unexpected mistake of mine.

Please Disable Steam Input.
Right Click Tool Name -> Property... -> Controller -> Disable Steam Input

Steam input is an item that cannot be changed by the developer, so I apologize for the inconvenience, but please handle it individually.

[strike]I don't think I've changed anything about this. Steam, are you?[/strike]

notes.title: Screen sharing function integrated
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753840/3b67168480043d87d43a67776de64c16288f983b.png[/img]

A beta version of NFJJ plus, an integrated screen sharing function, has been released.
You can now easily use the same functions as [url=https://www.pneumagamez.com/products/netfriendcapicapture/index.html]Net Friend Capi Capture[/url].

It will take a long time to install at the first startup, but please be patient.
Inside is a Microsoft Edge browser for embedding programs.
Please be assured that it is not a suspicious item.
I think it will be about the same speed as when using Capi Caputure on Edge.
If Microsoft works hard, the function will be improved semi-automatically.

Do your best Microsoft!

The function is more complicated, so please let me know if it doesn't work ...
